## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!piano` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --pink: #ff4f8b; --orange: #ff8a3d; --yellow: #ffc93c; --lime: #9be15d; --mint: #2ed8a7; --sky: #38b6ff; --violet: #7c5cff; --grape: #b44cff; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; --muted: #5b4c86; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; background: radial-gradient(90% 60% at 0% 0%, rgba(255, 79, 139, .22), rgba(255, 79, 139, 0) 70%), radial-gradient(80% 60% at 100% 0%, rgba(56, 182, 255, .25), rgba(56, 182, 255, 0) 70%), var(--cream); }
  button { font: inherit; color: inherit; border: 0; background: none; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; }
  button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--violet); outline-offset: 2px; }
  svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.3; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; display: block; }
  #app { height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 12px; }
  .top { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 34px; }
  h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 19px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; }
  .spacer { flex: 1; }
  #note { min-width: 96px; max-width: 58%; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; }
  #note i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mint); flex: none; }
  .seg { flex: none; display: flex; gap: 6px; height: 40px; }
  .seg button { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #e2d3bb; transition: transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease, background .2s ease, color .2s ease; }
  .seg button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--violet), var(--grape)); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #4f2ba8; }
  .seg button:active, .tool:active, #tune:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #e2d3bb; }
  .bar { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 38px; }
  .tool { width: 38px; height: 38px; flex: none; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 800; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #e2d3bb; transition: transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease; }
  .tool:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: default; }
  #range { min-width: 58px; text-align: center; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  #vol { flex: 1; min-width: 40px; accent-color: var(--grape); height: 28px; }
  .piano { flex: 1; min-height: 0; padding: 10px 8px 8px; border-radius: 20px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--violet), var(--grape) 55%, var(--pink)); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #5a2bb0; }
  #keys { position: relative; height: 100%; display: flex; gap: 2px; touch-action: none; }
  .key { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 100%; border-radius: 0 0 9px 9px; background: #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 -7px 0 var(--c), 0 3px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .35); display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; padding-bottom: 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--ink); transition: transform .08s ease, background .08s ease; }
  .key.on { transform: translateY(2px); background: linear-gradient(var(--p), var(--p)) #fff; box-shadow: inset 0 -7px 0 var(--c), 0 1px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .35); }
  .key.black { position: absolute; top: 0; height: 60%; flex: none; z-index: 2; border-radius: 0 0 7px 7px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2c2160, var(--ink)); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .45); padding: 0; }
  .key.black.on { background: var(--c); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .45); }
  .foot { flex: none; display: flex; gap: 8px; height: 46px; }
  #tune { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #e2d3bb; padding: 0 10px; text-align: left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; transition: transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease; }
  #tune small { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 700; }
  #tune span { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  #demo { flex: none; min-width: 132px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 16px; color: #fff; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--pink), var(--orange)); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #b8325f; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; transition: transform .12s ease, box-shadow .12s ease; }
  #demo:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #b8325f; }
  #demo svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .key, .key.on { transition: none; transform: none; } }
</style>
<main id="app">
  <header class="top">
    <h1>🎹 Mini piano</h1>
    <span class="spacer"></span>
    <span id="note" aria-live="polite">Tap a key</span>
  </header>
  <div class="seg" id="inst" role="group" aria-label="Instrument"></div>
  <div class="bar">
    <button class="tool" id="down" type="button" aria-label="Octave down">−</button>
    <span id="range" aria-live="polite"></span>
    <button class="tool" id="up" type="button" aria-label="Octave up">+</button>
    <span class="spacer"></span>
    <button class="tool" id="mute" type="button" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Mute"></button>
    <input id="vol" type="range" min="0" max="100" value="70" aria-label="Volume">
  </div>
  <div class="piano"><div id="keys" role="group" aria-label="Piano keys, two octaves"></div></div>
  <div class="foot">
    <button id="tune" type="button" aria-label="Change tune"><small>Tune · tap to change</small><span id="tuneName"></span></button>
    <button id="demo" type="button"></button>
  </div>
</main>
<script>
  var TEXT = { idle: "Tap a key", play: "Play a tune", stop: "Stop", noSound: "No sound here" };
  var NAMES = ["C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F", "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B"];
  var COLORS = ["#ff4f8b", "#ff8a3d", "#ffc93c", "#9be15d", "#2ed8a7", "#38b6ff", "#7c5cff"];
  var WHITE = [0, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9, 11];
  var INSTRUMENTS = ["Soft", "Bell", "Chip"];
  // Public-domain melodies: note + octave, optional :beats.
  var TUNES = [
    { name: "Twinkle Twinkle", bpm: 132, notes: "C4 C4 G4 G4 A4 A4 G4:2 F4 F4 E4 E4 D4 D4 C4:2 G4 G4 F4 F4 E4 E4 D4:2 G4 G4 F4 F4 E4 E4 D4:2 C4 C4 G4 G4 A4 A4 G4:2 F4 F4 E4 E4 D4 D4 C4:2" },
    { name: "Ode to Joy", bpm: 140, notes: "E4 E4 F4 G4 G4 F4 E4 D4 C4 C4 D4 E4 E4:1.5 D4:.5 D4:2 E4 E4 F4 G4 G4 F4 E4 D4 C4 C4 D4 E4 D4:1.5 C4:.5 C4:2" },
    { name: "Frère Jacques", bpm: 120, notes: "F4 G4 A4 F4 F4 G4 A4 F4 A4 A#4 C5:2 A4 A#4 C5:2 C5:.5 D5:.5 C5:.5 A#4:.5 A4 F4 C5:.5 D5:.5 C5:.5 A#4:.5 A4 F4 F4 C4 F4:2 F4 C4 F4:2" }
  ];
  var MIN_OCT = 2, MAX_OCT = 5;
  var ICON = {
    vol: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M11 5 6 9H2v6h4l5 4z" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M15.5 8.5a5 5 0 0 1 0 7M19 5a10 10 0 0 1 0 14"/></svg>',
    mute: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M11 5 6 9H2v6h4l5 4z" fill="currentColor"/><path d="m22 9-6 6M16 9l6 6"/></svg>',
    play: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M7 4.5v15L19.5 12z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>',
    stop: '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12" rx="2" fill="currentColor"/></svg>'
  };

  var AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
  var ac = null, master = null, comp = null, tuneBus = null, tuneEvents = [], raf = 0;
  var S = { oct: 4, inst: 0, vol: .7, muted: false, tune: 0, playing: false };
  var held = {}, voices = {}, pointers = {}, keyEls = {}, lastNote = "";
  var stats = { voices: 0 };
  var $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };

  function mtof(m) { return 440 * Math.pow(2, (m - 69) / 12); }
  function nameOf(m) { return NAMES[m % 12] + (Math.floor(m / 12) - 1); }
  function parseNote(s) {
    var parts = s.split(":"), n = parts[0], sharp = n.charAt(1) === "#";
    var pc = NAMES.indexOf(n.charAt(0)) + (sharp ? 1 : 0), oct = Number(n.slice(sharp ? 2 : 1));
    return { m: (oct + 1) * 12 + pc, beats: parts[1] ? Number(parts[1]) : 1 };
  }

  function buildChain(c) {
    var m = c.createGain(), k = c.createDynamicsCompressor();
    k.threshold.value = -12; k.knee.value = 10; k.ratio.value = 5; k.attack.value = .003; k.release.value = .2;
    m.connect(k); k.connect(c.destination);
    return { master: m, comp: k };
  }

  // Starts one note on out at time t; returns release(time).
  function voice(c, out, m, t, inst) {
    var f = mtof(m), g = c.createGain(), nodes = [], stopAt;
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t);
    g.connect(out);
    function osc(type, freq, dest) { var o = c.createOscillator(); o.type = type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t); o.connect(dest); o.start(t); nodes.push(o); return o; }
    if (inst === 0) {
      var lp = c.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = "lowpass"; lp.frequency.setValueAtTime(2600, t); lp.connect(g);
      osc("triangle", f, lp);
      var h = c.createGain(); h.gain.value = .18; h.connect(lp); osc("sine", f * 2, h);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.24, t + .012);
      g.gain.setTargetAtTime(.13, t + .012, .35);
    } else if (inst === 1) {
      var mod = c.createGain();
      mod.gain.setValueAtTime(f * 2.2, t);
      mod.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, t, .25);
      var car = osc("sine", f, g);
      osc("sine", f * 3.5, mod);
      mod.connect(car.frequency);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.22, t + .003);
      g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, t + .003, .7);
    } else {
      var lp2 = c.createBiquadFilter(); lp2.type = "lowpass"; lp2.frequency.setValueAtTime(3800, t); lp2.connect(g);
      osc("square", f, lp2);
      g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.14, t + .003);
      g.gain.setTargetAtTime(.1, t + .003, .15);
    }
    stats.voices++;
    return function (rt) {
      rt = Math.max(rt, t + .03);
      var rel = inst === 1 ? .35 : inst === 2 ? .04 : .25;
      g.gain.cancelScheduledValues(rt);
      g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, rt, rel / 5);
      stopAt = rt + rel + .05;
      for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) nodes[i].stop(stopAt);
      setTimeout(function () { g.disconnect(); }, (stopAt - c.currentTime) * 1000 + 100);
    };
  }

  function unlock() {
    if (!AC) { $("note").textContent = TEXT.noSound; return false; }
    if (!ac) { ac = new AC(); var ch = buildChain(ac); master = ch.master; comp = ch.comp; applyVolume(); }
    if (ac.state === "suspended") ac.resume();
    return true;
  }

  function applyVolume() {
    if (!master) return;
    master.gain.setTargetAtTime(S.muted ? 0 : S.vol * S.vol, ac.currentTime, .02);
  }

  function noteOn(m) {
    held[m] = (held[m] || 0) + 1;
    setKey(m, true);
    lastNote = nameOf(m);
    showNotes();
    if (held[m] > 1 || !unlock()) return;
    if (voices[m]) voices[m](ac.currentTime);
    voices[m] = voice(ac, master, m, ac.currentTime + .005, S.inst);
  }

  function noteOff(m) {
    if (!held[m]) return;
    held[m]--;
    if (held[m] > 0) return;
    delete held[m];
    setKey(m, false);
    if (voices[m] && ac) { voices[m](ac.currentTime); delete voices[m]; }
    showNotes();
  }

  function allOff() { for (var m in held) { held[m] = 1; noteOff(Number(m)); } pointers = {}; }

  function showNotes() {
    var names = [];
    for (var m in held) names.push(Number(m));
    names.sort(function (a, b) { return a - b; });
    var text = names.length ? names.map(nameOf).join(" ") : (lastNote || TEXT.idle);
    var el = $("note");
    el.textContent = "";
    if (names.length || lastNote) { var dot = document.createElement("i"); dot.style.background = colorFor(names.length ? names[0] : parseNote(lastNote).m); el.appendChild(dot); }
    el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
  }

  function colorFor(m) { var pc = m % 12, w = WHITE.indexOf(pc); return COLORS[w >= 0 ? w : WHITE.indexOf(pc + 1)]; }

  function setKey(m, on) { var el = keyEls[m]; if (el) el.classList.toggle("on", on); }

  function hexA(hex, a) { var n = parseInt(hex.slice(1), 16); return "rgba(" + (n >> 16) + "," + ((n >> 8) & 255) + "," + (n & 255) + "," + a + ")"; }

  function buildKeys() {
    var box = $("keys"), base = (S.oct + 1) * 12, w = 0, i, m;
    allOff();
    box.textContent = "";
    keyEls = {};
    for (i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
      m = base + i;
      var pc = i % 12, isWhite = WHITE.indexOf(pc) !== -1, el = document.createElement("button");
      el.type = "button";
      el.className = "key" + (isWhite ? "" : " black");
      el.dataset.m = m;
      el.setAttribute("aria-label", nameOf(m));
      el.style.setProperty("--c", colorFor(m));
      el.style.setProperty("--p", hexA(colorFor(m), .6));
      if (isWhite) { el.textContent = pc === 0 ? nameOf(m) : NAMES[pc]; w++; }
      else el.style.cssText += ";width:calc((100% - 26px) / 14 * .62);left:calc((100% - 26px) / 14 * " + (w - .31) + " + " + (2 * w - 1) + "px)";
      box.appendChild(el);
      keyEls[m] = el;
    }
    $("range").textContent = nameOf(base) + "–" + nameOf(base + 23);
    $("down").disabled = S.oct <= MIN_OCT;
    $("up").disabled = S.oct >= MAX_OCT;
    tuneEvents.forEach(function (ev) { ev.lit = false; });
  }

  function keyAt(x, y) {
    var el = document.elementFromPoint(x, y);
    el = el && el.closest ? el.closest(".key") : null;
    return el ? Number(el.dataset.m) : null;
  }

  function stopTune() {
    if (tuneBus) {
      var bus = tuneBus, now = ac.currentTime;
      bus.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now);
      bus.gain.setValueAtTime(bus.gain.value, now);
      bus.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, now + .05);
      setTimeout(function () { bus.disconnect(); }, 200);
    }
    tuneBus = null;
    tuneEvents.forEach(function (ev) { if (ev.lit) setKey(ev.m, !!held[ev.m]); });
    tuneEvents = [];
    S.playing = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    renderDemo();
  }

  function playTune() {
    if (!unlock()) return;
    var tune = TUNES[S.tune], notes = tune.notes.split(" ").map(parseNote), beat = 60 / tune.bpm, lo = 999, hi = 0;
    notes.forEach(function (n) { lo = Math.min(lo, n.m); hi = Math.max(hi, n.m); });
    var base = (S.oct + 1) * 12;
    if (lo < base || hi > base + 23) { S.oct = Math.max(MIN_OCT, Math.min(MAX_OCT, Math.floor(lo / 12) - 1)); buildKeys(); }
    var start = function () {
      if (!S.playing) return;
      tuneBus = ac.createGain(); tuneBus.connect(master);
      var t = ac.currentTime + .15;
      tuneEvents = notes.map(function (n) {
        var len = n.beats * beat, ev = { m: n.m, t: t, end: t + len * .9, lit: false };
        var rel = voice(ac, tuneBus, n.m, t, S.inst);
        rel(t + len * .9);
        t += len;
        return ev;
      });
      loop();
    };
    S.playing = true;
    renderDemo();
    if (ac.state === "running") start(); else ac.resume().then(start);
  }

  function loop() {
    cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    var frame = function () {
      if (!S.playing || !tuneEvents.length) return;
      var now = ac.currentTime, last = tuneEvents[tuneEvents.length - 1];
      for (var i = 0; i < tuneEvents.length; i++) {
        var ev = tuneEvents[i], on = now >= ev.t && now < ev.end;
        if (on && !ev.lit) { ev.lit = true; setKey(ev.m, true); lastNote = nameOf(ev.m); showNotes(); }
        else if (!on && ev.lit) { ev.lit = false; setKey(ev.m, !!held[ev.m]); }
      }
      if (now > last.end + .1) { tuneEvents = []; stopTune(); return; }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function renderDemo() {
    $("demo").innerHTML = (S.playing ? ICON.stop : ICON.play) + "<span>" + (S.playing ? TEXT.stop : TEXT.play) + "</span>";
    $("tuneName").textContent = TUNES[S.tune].name;
  }

  function renderInst() {
    var box = $("inst");
    box.textContent = "";
    INSTRUMENTS.forEach(function (name, i) {
      var b = document.createElement("button");
      b.type = "button"; b.textContent = name;
      b.setAttribute("aria-pressed", i === S.inst);
      b.addEventListener("click", function () { S.inst = i; renderInst(); if (unlock()) { var r = voice(ac, master, 72, ac.currentTime + .01, i); r(ac.currentTime + .2); } });
      box.appendChild(b);
    });
  }

  function renderVolume() {
    $("mute").innerHTML = S.muted || S.vol === 0 ? ICON.mute : ICON.vol;
    $("mute").setAttribute("aria-pressed", S.muted);
    $("mute").setAttribute("aria-label", S.muted ? "Unmute" : "Mute");
  }

  var keys = $("keys");
  keys.addEventListener("pointerdown", function (e) {
    e.preventDefault();
    try { keys.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); } catch (x) {}
    var m = keyAt(e.clientX, e.clientY);
    pointers[e.pointerId] = m;
    if (m !== null) noteOn(m);
  });
  keys.addEventListener("pointermove", function (e) {
    if (!(e.pointerId in pointers)) return;
    var m = keyAt(e.clientX, e.clientY), was = pointers[e.pointerId];
    if (m === was) return;
    if (was !== null) noteOff(was);
    pointers[e.pointerId] = m;
    if (m !== null) noteOn(m);
  });
  function lift(e) {
    if (!(e.pointerId in pointers)) return;
    var was = pointers[e.pointerId];
    delete pointers[e.pointerId];
    if (was !== null) noteOff(was);
  }
  keys.addEventListener("pointerup", function (e) { lift(e); unlock(); });
  keys.addEventListener("pointercancel", lift);
  keys.addEventListener("lostpointercapture", lift);
  keys.addEventListener("contextmenu", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
  // Keyboard users: Enter/Space on a focused key plays a short note.
  keys.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    if (e.detail !== 0) return;
    var el = e.target.closest(".key");
    if (!el) return;
    var m = Number(el.dataset.m);
    noteOn(m);
    setTimeout(function () { noteOff(m); }, 300);
  });
  document.addEventListener("touchend", function () { if (ac && ac.state === "suspended") ac.resume(); });

  $("down").addEventListener("click", function () { if (S.oct > MIN_OCT) { S.oct--; buildKeys(); } });
  $("up").addEventListener("click", function () { if (S.oct < MAX_OCT) { S.oct++; buildKeys(); } });
  $("mute").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (S.vol === 0) { S.vol = .5; $("vol").value = 50; S.muted = false; } else S.muted = !S.muted;
    unlock(); applyVolume(); renderVolume();
  });
  $("vol").addEventListener("input", function () { S.vol = Number(this.value) / 100; if (S.vol > 0) S.muted = false; applyVolume(); renderVolume(); });
  $("demo").addEventListener("click", function () { S.playing ? stopTune() : playTune(); });
  $("tune").addEventListener("click", function () { var was = S.playing; if (was) stopTune(); S.tune = (S.tune + 1) % TUNES.length; renderDemo(); });

  renderInst();
  renderVolume();
  renderDemo();
  buildKeys();
</script>
`

client.command('piano', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Mini piano",
    height: 400,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "The mini piano opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
  })
})
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Height | 400 px |
| Size | 18.6 KB |
| Input | Tap, Swipe |
| Tested | Not yet tested on a phone |

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
